messages:
Maria C.: Heads-up — MidSea procurement pinged for SOC2 evidence + DPA clarifications tied to their upcoming renewal. They want a small evidence packet by EOD tomorrow.
Evan (MidSea): Thanks Maria. Primary asks: log retention timelines, encryption at rest for embeddings, and whether we can provide any redacted SOC2 artifacts.
Maria C.: Noted. @Jordan S. can you confirm retention policies for auth logs, inference traces, and where keys are managed? Also KMS rotation cadence.
Jordan S.: Auth logs = 13 months (audit bucket). Inference traces = 90 days default. Embeddings are not stored unless customer enables vector storage; for MidSea we have a 30-day retention. KMS keys are managed in AWS KMS under alias `alias/redwood-prod-logs` with a 12-month rotation cadence; manual rotation supported on request.
Alyssa R.: Legal asked for S3 paths and a one-page summary they can attach to the DPA. I can create that doc but need exact S3 prefixes + short retention statements.
Jordan S.: S3 prefixes: `s3://redwood-audit/auth-logs/`, `s3://redwood-audit/inference-traces/`, `s3://redwood-embeddings/vector-exports/` (customer-specific). Add a note: encryption-at-rest via KMS; TLS in transit.
Maria C.: Great. @Alyssa build the one-pager with: S3 locations, retention durations, KMS alias, contact (Jordan S.), plus a small blurb on Dedicated customers' ability to customize retention for compliance.
Alyssa R.: Working on it. Quick question: should we include the exact CLI snippet to demonstrate access for their security team? Might help procurement.
Jordan S.: Good idea. Add this snippet to show where evidence can be listed:
```
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-audit/auth-logs/ --recursive --profile redwood-audit | grep 2026
```
Maria C.: Also flag: if MidSea requests the full SOC2 attestation report, we need Legal approval to share a redacted copy. That could delay the timeline — marking as a renewal risk.
Evan (MidSea): Understood. If you can share the one-pager + DPA note first, procurement can proceed while Legal works on attestation request.
Alyssa R.: Draft ready in ~90 minutes. Will include: evidence paths, short retention table, encryption statement, CLI snippet, and a line: "SOC2 attestation available on request; sharing requires legal review."
Legal-bot: Reminder: any request for attestation artifacts triggers data room workflow. Contact LegalOps with ticket #LR-4432.
Jordan S.: Added a note in the doc about Dedicated: admins can configure retention via the Dedicated settings API; will link internal how-to.
Maria C.: Thanks team — once Alyssa posts the draft I will QA and send to Evan, cc LegalOps. Keeping this thread for any follow-ups or procurement questions.
Evan (MidSea): That plan works. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
Alyssa R.: Uploading doc to internal share now and will paste link here when done.
Maria C.: Risk recap for internal tracker: potential delay if attestation requested; otherwise on-track to meet EOD tomorrow.
Alyssa R.: Link: https://files.redwood.internal/packets/midsea-evidence-2267771234 (internal only)
Maria C.: Sent to Evan + Procurement; LegalOps looped in for potential attestation share. Closing out unless procurement asks for more.
